colour.rule: chromatic share per codebook cell, neutrals out of the numerator and the denominator. A cell is DOMINANT when it is the largest chromatic cell and holds >= 0.1, or when it holds >= 0.15 on its own; a picture may have more than one and may have none. The same rule over codebook.rollup families at 0.2 / 0.3. No floor on the raw share.

why_not_tracked: one row per recipe at about a kilobyte and a half a row, which is tens of megabytes against a 1 MiB per-file history guard, and rewritten whole on every backfill because the store upserts by key. The manifest is what the history keeps; the bytes live on both tiers.
